title: Pixel Loom
tagline: A little world, one pixel at a time.
description: A local-first pixel-art and flipbook editor. Draw on transparent layers, animate small sprites, and export PNG frames or sprite sheets.
features: Pixel pencil, eraser, fill, picker, line and rectangle tools
Named transparent layers with opacity and visibility
32-frame flipbook with onion skin and playback
Editable project save/open and browser autosave
Transparent PNG and horizontal sprite-sheet export
